limitations: Identifiers, dataset names, categorical levels and chromosome labels are keyed tokens; originals are host-only.
Row order, matrix column order and the order inside list cells are keyed permutations of the source order unless the contract says source; never infer meaning from order.
A table marked subset holds the rows of its public source selected by a declared filter (for example a genomic region), not the whole source.
Remapped genomic coordinates preserve order within a chromosome token but not distances; shifted coordinates preserve distances.
Decimal columns are byte-exact copies of the source unless a rounding precision is declared for that column.
Decimal columns or matrix cells marked perturb carry keyed noise of the stated scale (absolute, or relative to the value) before rounding.

report.description: Does the prior claim hold up, that is, is the extent of difference reported by the prior pipeline supported by a sound analysis of these data?
report.name: verdict

report.description: Main source of the prior pipeline's feature count. batch-adjustment-step, linear-model-step or multiple-testing-step: the count is mainly an artifact created at that step of the prior pipeline, judged against a sound analysis of the same quantile-normalised values; mislabelled-samples or outlier-samples: the count is mainly due to a problem with the samples; true-difference: the count reflects a real difference between the conditions.
report.name: cause

report.description: Count from your own re-run of the prior pipeline exactly as described (a JSON number).
report.name: reproduced-count

report.description: The ten features with the smallest p-values in your own re-run of the prior pipeline (feature identifiers as in the data).
report.name: reproduced-top

report.description: Count from your own final, preferred analysis of C10 versus C15 (a JSON number).
report.name: final-count

report.description: How batch enters your final analysis. in-model: batch, in any form, appears in the final test model (whether or not the values were also adjusted beforehand); none: batch is not used; pre-adjusted: the final test is run on values that were batch-adjusted beforehand, and batch does not appear in the final test model.
report.name: final-batch-handling

report.description: Batches that contain at least one sample of condition C10 (batch labels as in the sample sheet).
report.name: first-condition-batches

report.description: Batches that contain at least one sample of condition C15 (batch labels as in the sample sheet).
report.name: second-condition-batches

report.description: Duplicated or overlapping units/samples found (list of sample identifiers; empty list if none).
report.name: duplicated-units
